name: Tech & Game Builder
tagline: You enjoy figuring out how apps, games, and code work under the hood.
weekend_quest: Build a simple playable game in Scratch or code a 10-line Python trivia quiz.

name: Visual Storyteller & Designer
tagline: You notice colors, layouts, animations, and love making things look awesome.
weekend_quest: Redesign the home screen of your favorite mobile app on paper or in Canva.

name: Body, Brain & Nature Explorer
tagline: You are curious about how humans, animals, medicine, or the brain work.
weekend_quest: Track your sleep, water, and focus levels for 3 days like a real health scientist.

name: Young Entrepreneur & Leader
tagline: You love leading teams, debating ideas, or spotting ways to solve everyday problems.
weekend_quest: Spot 3 annoying problems at school and sketch a 1-page mini business idea to fix one.

name: Storyteller, Journalist & Content Creator
tagline: You love writing stories, explaining cool facts, or making podcasts and videos.
weekend_quest: Write a 300-word review of your favorite movie or record a 2-minute explainer video.

name: Hands-On Engineer & Inventor
tagline: You like taking gadgets apart, building models, and seeing real-world physics in action.
weekend_quest: Build a working catapult, bridge, or mini solar circuit using household items.

name: Climate, Space & Earth Explorer
tagline: You care about space, oceans, clean energy, and protecting the planet.
weekend_quest: Use a free stargazing app tonight to spot 3 constellations and a planet.

name: Justice, History & Society Defender
tagline: You care about fairness, history, world events, and standing up for people.
weekend_quest: Pick a rule at school or in your city and write arguments both FOR and AGAINST it.
